column1: The noise cancellation is world-class, perfect for my daily commute!
Battery lasts forever. I only charge it once a week. Amazing quality.
Best sound quality I have ever heard in this price range.
Comfortable to wear for hours. The silicon tips fit perfectly.
Fast charging actually works. 10 minutes gives me 2 hours of music.
I love the deep bass. It makes watching movies so immersive.
The touch controls are very responsive and easy to learn.
Packaging was premium and delivery was very fast. Great service.
